cards.title: Acoustic Chill
cards.description: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar loops layered with soft room reverb. Built for long focus sessions where silence feels too empty.
cards.highlight: The perfect background for three hours of deep work.

cards.title: Electronic Energy
cards.description: Hard-hitting electronic production with driving basslines and layered synths. The kind of music that makes you feel unstoppable.
cards.highlight: Turns any task into something worth attacking.

cards.title: Jazz Essentials
cards.description: A curated walk through essential jazz — from Miles Davis cool to Coltrane sheets of sound to modern neo-soul crossovers.
cards.highlight: Sixty years of jazz distilled into one essential listen.

cards.title: Lo-Fi Coding
cards.description: Dusty drum samples, muted chords, and tape-saturated textures. The sound of productive late nights and clean git commits.
cards.highlight: Ship more code per hour. Scientifically unverified but widely believed.

cards.title: Morning Motivation
cards.description: Upbeat, bright, and impossible to feel sluggish to. Carefully sequenced to build energy from the first track to the last.
cards.highlight: Your alarm should feel this good.

cards.title: Deep Focus
cards.description: Generative ambient textures that shift slowly over long durations. Designed to mask distraction without ever demanding attention.
cards.highlight: Two hours in and you forget it's even playing.

cards.title: Synthwave Nights
cards.description: Neon-soaked 80s-inspired production with lush pads, gated reverb, and that unmistakable feeling of driving at midnight.
cards.highlight: Sounds like a movie you wish they had made.

cards.title: Piano Reflections
cards.description: Solo piano recordings captured in a single room with natural acoustics. Intimate, unhurried, and deeply human.
cards.highlight: Every note feels like it was played just for you.

cards.title: Workout Beats
cards.description: High BPM, relentless energy, and drops timed perfectly for peak effort moments. Built to make you push past the wall.
cards.highlight: Your last rep always finds another gear with this on.

cards.title: Late Night Vibes
cards.description: Slow, smoky, and cinematic. The kind of music that makes a quiet apartment at 2am feel like the best place on earth.

cards.title: Afrobeats Now
cards.description: The freshest Afrobeats and Amapiano tracks dominating charts across Lagos, London, and everywhere in between right now.
cards.highlight: The sound the whole world is catching up to.

cards.title: Sunset Sessions
cards.description: Warm, melodic house and downtempo tracks sequenced to match the exact feeling of watching the sky change colour at dusk.
cards.highlight: Matches the sky colour for colour as it fades.
